description: Top-performing TikTok ads from the Creative Center. Each row includes the ad ID, title, brand, CTR, likes, cost tier, industry and objective names, video renditions, rank and market, and optional landing page, target countries, comments, shares, source, retention curve, and Spotlight commentary.

data.description: Dataset containing one row per unique Top Ads creative. Existing fields adId, adUrl, adTitle, brandName, cost, ctr, like, industryKey, objectiveKey, isSearch, observedCountry, observedPeriod, scrapedAt, videoCoverUrl, videoDuration, videoHeight, videoWidth, videoId, and videoUrls are preserved; new fields are additive.
